inputs: parent R0 rebuilt byte-identically by scripts/rebuild_r0.py
recipe.response: per-band: nodata-fill with footprint median -> gaussian sigma=1.0 px -> robust_unit (median/IQR z, 1.0 = 99.5th pct) -> pixel-wise max
recipe.determinism: no RNG; candidates ordered by response, then distance, then (dy,dx)

mechanism_card.hypothesis: R0's dots are placed by a purely geometric BFS Poisson-disk walk over the H19-5 lineament field, so a dot can sit 1 px off the geophysical edge that nominated the lineament. Under the 300 m triangular kernel that misplacement costs up to 1/3 of the credit available from a truth pixel.
mechanism_card.mechanism: Each dot may move to the highest fused tmi_hg / iso_grav_anom_hg response inside a 1.42 px (8-neighbour) disc, but only if that response beats its own by >= 0.02 of the robust-unit dynamic range. Count, mass and exclusions are unchanged.
mechanism_card.non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted lithologic contacts, dike/swarm margins, pluton edges, caldera ring fractures and alluvial-fan apron breaks produce the same horizontal-gradient crest in both bands; snapping onto them moves mass off faults and onto contacts.
mechanism_card.prediction_basis: pure position change => dDTI ~= dT / D with D = 18734.44 from the recorded live-anchor inversion (T = 5073.29, DTI = 0.2708) in evidence/incumbent_anatomy.json; scenario = 10%-25% of moved dots close one full pixel of gap (kernel gain 1/3 each). Evidence class MODEL, not a score.
mechanism_card.falsifier: live change <= +0.004 (i.e. < 0.01 above the parent's 0.2778 CLAIM) means no evidence for the snap mechanism; a live change of -0.01 or worse falsifies it and says the TMI/gravity crests R0 was pulled onto are non-fault contacts.

form_note: R0 + snap 1p4px-g0p02 (2,416/37,654 dots moved, mean 1.38 px); predicted +0.004..+0.011
